responsibility: Provides the main rs6000 subtarget configuration for PowerPC Darwin/Mac OS X. It adapts the generic backend to the Mach-O object format, Darwin ABI conventions, PIC defaults, predefined macros, library/crt selection, alignment rules, Objective-C and exception runtime quirks, builtin patching, pragma handling, and Darwin-specific long double and Altivec behavior, covering both 32-bit and 64-bit PowerPC Darwin targets.
same_name_distinction: Among the Darwin files, this is the broad subtarget configuration header: it sets Mach-O/Darwin macros, specs, ABI defaults, and hook bindings, whereas darwin.md supplies Darwin-specific RTL patterns and darwin.opt only lists option metadata.
